text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Haa... Haa... Haa...――

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I did it...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I was able to... get results... in a 
GⅠ...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(Still, as expected... G1 races take a 
heavy toll...—)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I must accept this too... so that I can 
fight in the battles ahead...—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Man, Ikuno Dictus is impressive...! 
Honestly, that might've been even beyond 
my expectations.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder if she'll stick with the Tiara 
route. She might grow even more from here 
on out...!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...A powerful run, as if to prove the 
dedication of your daily discipline—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I have seared it firmly into my eyes...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —I have returned.
choice_data_list: Welcome back! That was an incredible run!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. I felt a good 
response as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today on the turf, Ikuno Dictus proved 
beyond a doubt that she possesses the 
caliber required to challenge a GⅠ race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With this, I can take on the Tiara route 
in the Classic year without any 
worries...!
choice_data_list:
Alright, let's head back to the waiting 
room and check your condition

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed. I must record this in 'IRON 
WILL' as well—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Returning to the waiting room, I measured 
Ikuno Dictus's condition using 'IRON 
WILL'—

text_block_list.name: IRON WILL
text_block_list.text:
“—Measurement complete. Estimated fatigue: 
89%. Immediate action for fatigue recovery 
is highly recommended.”

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...So it is as I thought.
choice_data_list: Are you even aware of it?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. For a little while now, I've felt 
this creeping sense of exhaustion.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Right after the race, it was likely 
suppressed by a state close to a runner's 
high. It seems that began to fade as time 
passed—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing that Ikuno Dictus seemed only 
normally fatigued upon her return, I 
honestly let my guard down too...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It really drives home the fact that even 
after a GⅠ race is over, you can't let 
your guard down for a second."
choice_data_list: Alright, let's take care of it right away.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I quickly prepare the contingency measures 
planned in advance for heavy post-race 
fatigue—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —All stretching routines: completed.
choice_data_list:
Get some nutrition in during your next ice 
massage.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Understood.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
—Pardon me. I am Mejiro McQueen, from 
Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If it is alright... I would like to meet 
with Ikuno-san.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: McQueen-san...!?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I am currently undergoing 
after-maintenance, but if at all possible—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The urgent procedures were complete, and 
Ikuno Dictus's fatigue seemed to be 
settling down, so I determined she would 
be fine.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Please, come in.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry to bother you when you must be 
exhausted right after the race. Thank you 
so much—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...! Ikuno-san, are you hurt anywhere...!?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
No. The fatigue was quite severe, so I was 
simply doing some urgent maintenance here 
with my Trainer.
choice_data_list: I've calmed down now, so I'm okay.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Just as expected.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Both of you are so thorough, never getting 
carried away even after delivering 
results—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Seeing that braces me to follow their 
example as well.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: McQueen-san...—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...I am deeply touched that you went 
through the trouble of coming all the way 
to Hanshin."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Of course I would! It's the monumental big 
race for my cherished roommate, after 
all...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
However, since you didn't mention coming 
all the way to the venue yesterday, I was 
honestly surprised.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Well, uh... how should I put it? It was 
sort of... a surprise, you could say.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I see. In that case, it was a massive 
success.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I'm happy. Very much so.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm glad you liked it... I'm quite 
relieved as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: …………Ikuno-san.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
One day, without fail, I shall show you as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"The way you powerfully demonstrate your 
hard-won discipline through your running, 
just like that—"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...I'm looking forward to it, very much.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...And so, Ikuno Dictus's first GⅠ 
challenge came to a successful and 
promising close—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Then as expected, the next goal is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The first crown of the Triple Tiara. A 
1600m turf mile GⅠ at Hanshin Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since Ikuno Dictus ran so well in the 
Hanshin JF, which is held over the exact 
same Hanshin turf 1600m track, she has 
more than a fighting chance...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...I can truly aim for them, can't I? The 
Classic races... me...—"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. Please allow me to reaffirm my 
resolve, right here and now.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: 『IRON WILL』。

text_block_list.name: IRON WILL
text_block_list.text: “—Please state your business.”

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Please set the target race. The settings 
are—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"The Triple Tiara. The Oka Sho, the Oaks, 
and the Shuka Sho."

text_block_list.name: IRON WILL
text_block_list.text:
"I have set the Oka Sho, Yushun Himba 
(Japanese Oaks), and Shuka Sho as 
targets."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: "...This is a declaration. And—"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"By engraving it beforehand into 'IRON 
WILL,' I intend to turn this declaration 
into a solemn oath."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
A resolve to run through this Tiara route 
without ever stopping her stride—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: To an ironclad oath.
choice_data_list:
...I promise I'll see you run all the way 
to the end, too.

...I will make sure you run all the way to 
the end, too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To run longer than anyone else from here 
on out. Believing this resolve will become 
a source of strength for Ikuno Dictus and 
myself, I will etch it into my heart.
choice_data_list: Here and now, I swear to you
Here and now, I swear to you

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: “......Thank you very much, Trainer-san.”

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that... my resolve has been 
forged into something even stronger.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tempering a new resolve, our first target 
is the "Oka Sho"...!
